learning_path:
**Course Recommendations**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX2972 | International Human Rights Law | edx | Foundational knowledge of human rights law |
| 2 | EDX2117 | International Humanitarian Law | edx | Builds on foundational knowledge, focusing on humanitarian law |
| 3 | EDX1241 | International Law | edx | Explores the broader context of international law, including its relationship with human rights and humanitarian law |
| 4 | EDX3160 | Asylum and Refugee Law | edx | Delves into a specific area of human rights law, asylum and refugee law |
| 5 | EDX660 | Child Protection: Children's Rights in Theory and Practice | edx | Applies human rights and humanitarian law to a specific context, child protection |
| 6 | EDX2876 | (English) International Standards on Freedom of Expression and Safety of Journalists | edx | Examines the intersection of human rights and international law in the context of freedom of expression and safety of journalists |
| 7 | EDX2770 | Freedom of Expression and Information in the Time of Globalization: Foundational Course | edx | Provides a foundational understanding of freedom of expression and information in the context of globalization |
| 8 | EDX3071 | International Investment Law | edx | Explores the intersection of human rights and international law in the context of international investment law |
| 9 | EDX2826 | The EU and Human Rights | edx | Examines the relationship between the European Union and human rights law |
| 10 | EDX496 | Contemporary Issues in World Politics | edx | Encourages critical thinking and analysis of complex issues in world politics, including human rights and international law |

**How the path fits together**

This course path provides a comprehensive understanding of human rights and international humanitarian law, starting with foundational knowledge and building towards more complex and nuanced topics. The path covers the full duration requested, with at least one course per period. Each course follows logically from the previous one, with EDX2972 providing foundational knowledge of human rights law, which is built upon in EDX2117 with a focus on humanitarian law. EDX1241 explores the broader context of international law, while EDX3160 and EDX660 delve into specific areas of human rights law, asylum and refugee law, and child protection, respectively. EDX2876 and EDX2770 examine the intersection of human rights and international law in the context of freedom of expression and safety of journalists, and freedom of expression and information in the context of globalization, respectively. EDX3071 explores the intersection of human rights and international law in the context of international investment law, while EDX2826 examines the relationship between the European Union and human rights law. Finally, EDX496 encourages critical thinking and analysis of complex issues in world politics, including human rights and international law.
